stops.title: The church addressed
stops.text: A Roman colony in Macedonia where Paul founded the church with Lydia and the jailer, and where he was beaten and jailed.

stops.title: Where they sent help
stops.text: The Philippians sent aid to Paul more than once when he was in Thessalonica.

stops.title: Where Paul is probably held
stops.text: The "imperial guard" and "Caesar's household" fit Rome, the traditional place of Paul's imprisonment, though the letter doesn't name the city.
